proved.statement: For a two-dimensional Parseval frame with every squared row norm at most 1/2, there is an original-index partition J,K with det(S_J)det(S_K)>=1/640 and lambda_min(S_J),lambda_min(S_K)>=1/640.
The two disjoint original-coordinate transverse packets from that partition are independent and each has R^2 density cap at most e*sqrt(640)<68.768.
For arbitrary A with s3(A)>=1, selected-three-eigenspace leverage c at coordinate i implies ||A_(i,-i)||^2>=c-A_ii^2 and ||A_(-i,-i)||op>=1; c>=7/9 and |A_ii|<=1/4 give star norm >=sqrt(103)/12.
If in the preceding state some j satisfies |A_ij|>=1/2 and |A_jj|<=1/4, the physical pair theorem gives ||p_Q||infinity<49 for every arbitrary independent cap-one input law.

partner_application.application: Transfers the concrete finite-union interval inequality P(Q in I)<=48.658|I| on the near-null physical-pair branch to all arbitrary independent cap-one marginals with no constant loss.

near_zero_frontier: Combine the star lower bound ||b||^2>=c-a^2 and complementary ||C||op>=1 without replacing near-zero by exact-zero. Remaining local-star state has a diffuse star at the 1/2 atom scale or every >=1/2 star atom on a diagonal >1/4.
